name: v2 Falco: decoded payload in container
description: Falco rule 'Decoding Payload in Container' fired on the decoder process itself — an encoded blob decoded inside a container, the staging step of a decode-and-run chain. Narrowed to process.name because Falco's condition is a substring test (the command line holds the decoder's name and '-d' anywhere), so the parent shell line also matches, and so does any command that merely carries that text in its arguments. Triage answers what was decoded, whether it was then executed, and how the process reached the host. Falco's container.name is often <NA>; container.id identifies the host.
query: falco.rule: "Decoding Payload in Container" and process.name: "base64"
